extra:
## This work (Р-251, English works series, one at a time)

Source: the English original `star-on-the-shore-en` (text layer; `python -B pipeline/source/pages.py show star-on-the-shore-en <page>`; page image `python -B pipeline/source/pages.py image star-on-the-shore-en <physical page> --physical`). Page numbers: `pagemap` often misses printed numbers in these PDFs — look at 2–3 page images and find printed vs physical; in `sources` give the printed page as printed (null for unnumbered pages). Do NOT edit `pipeline/source/books.json` — report the offset (physical = printed − offset, e.g. «p. 3» on physical 4 → offset −1) and the lead sets it.
Russian text — our translation (flag `translated`); official Russian forms of names and terms — glossary `python -B tools/terms.py <word>` and existing records (Р-184), e.g. Dreamlands = «Страна грёз»; Hard/Extreme roll = «трудная/чрезвычайная проверка» (official «трудный/чрезвычайный успех», never «сложная»). New terms of this book — choose one Russian form each, use it everywhere, and list them all in your report (English → Russian); the translator of the book will reuse exactly these forms.
- FIRST: check that this scenario is not already in the base under a Russian translation (Grep key character and place names, transliterated, in `kb/books/*-ru/`; e.g. «The Haunted Clubhouse» was already there as «Маленький клуб ужасов»). If it is — do NOT create a second set: per Р-147 the translation keeps the text, the original gives the numbers; write proposals to the translation records (English sources, `name.en`, errata for translation errors) and report.
- 1920s New England: era 1920s. A location-based book split into 3 units — see «Shared scheme» below.
- One `scenario` record (summary, keeper_info, hook, advice, steps with refs, conclusion with Sanity rewards, tables), every scene (`arc`), characters (stat blocks as printed, Р-25; pregenerated investigators are characters with role `pregen`; unnamed crowds — group profile with invented `names`, Р-151), creatures (known Mythos creatures and deities → `instance_of` the shared record, Grep `kb/creatures` first; a unique being — book record), organizations, items and clues, tomes and spells (known spells → refs to the shared `coc:spell:*`), handouts (text as printed + our full translation), places (a real city — the shared record `coc:location:<city>` if it exists (Grep first), book places `part_of` it; a fictional town — a book place with its places `part_of` it; do not create shared records in `kb/locations/`), maps (`map` records with a spot on every printed label, Р-206; every key number without a record gets a small place record).
- Helper scripts — only in your own scratchpad subfolder `gen-star` (other helpers run in parallel and use the same scratchpad).
- Book-scoped ids `star-on-the-shore-en/<kind>/<slug>` in `kb/books/star-on-the-shore-en/<kinds>/`.
- Pictures (skill `.claude/skills/kb-art/SKILL.md`, Р-241, Р-245): portraits, creature art, handouts, item pictures, maps — mapping `checks/20261123-star/art.json`, `python -B pipeline/art/add_images.py … --dry-run` then real; apply the proposals yourself (`pipeline/integrate/apply.py`) — you own this book; atmosphere pictures (cover, decoration, mood art not tied to a record) → `checks/20261123-star/atmosphere.json` (the lead merges it). File prefix for pictures: `star-`.
- Lessons from earlier checks (skill kb-import, «Ошибки, которые уже находили»): every page of an entry in `sources`; handout texts in full; maps are `map` records, not atmosphere; no two records with the same `name.ru`; terms inside text agree with the record names; book misprints kept as printed, in `errata`, with the obvious ones fixed in `corrections`.
- When done, run `python -I -B tools/completeness.py --books star-on-the-shore-en --out checks/20261123-star/completeness` and `python -I -B tools/scenario_check.py --books star-on-the-shore-en --out checks/20261123-star/scenario` and fix what they find; then `python -B tools/check.py kb/books/star-on-the-shore-en` — 0 errors.
- Coverage: in `checks/20261123-star/star.md` list every heading of the book → the record that holds it (or «не взято» with the reason), misprints, and the term list (English → Russian).

## Shared scheme of this book (3 units work in parallel — keep to it exactly)

«The Star on the Shore: Struggles Against Evil in 1920s New England» (Ben Burns, Dark Cult Games under Chaosium licence, 2017). A 99-page SCAN with NO text layer: `pages.py show` gives OCR text with errors — read every page from its image (`pages.py image star-on-the-shore-en <phys> --physical`); numbers, names and stat blocks only from the image. Printed page numbers: find the offset on 2–3 page images (contents: Introduction p. 5, Keeper's Map 14, Upper Tunnels 51, Key to the Abyss 65, Player Aids 74, Maps 80, Pre-Generated Characters 84) and report it; do not edit books.json. Era `1920s`.
Contents (printed pages): Introduction 5, Prologue 5, Keeper's Secret 6, The Case 10, The City of Rockport 13, Keeper's Map 14, (numbered locations 14–50), Upper Tunnels 51, Upper Tunnels Map 52, Lower Tunnels 56, Lower Tunnels Map 57, Reference Section 59, Dreams 61, Cultist Summary 62, Key To The Abyss 65, Player Aids 74, Maps 80, Pre-Generated Characters 84.
- Rockport is the shared `coc:location:rockport` (exists — do not edit; additions by proposal). Book places `part_of` it or each other.
- Ids: the main scenario `star-on-the-shore-en/scenario/the-star-on-the-shore` (unit core), «Key to the Abyss» `star-on-the-shore-en/scenario/key-to-the-abyss` (unit abyss; `part_of` or `refs` to the main one — decide by how the book presents it and report); scenes `star-on-the-shore-en/scene/<star|abyss>-<slug>`; the numbered locations of Rockport `star-on-the-shore-en/location/loc-<N>-<slug>` (unit town), the tunnels `star-on-the-shore-en/location/upper-tunnels-<…>`, `lower-tunnels-<…>` (unit core); maps: Keeper's Map of Rockport (unit town), tunnel maps and the «Maps» section (unit core); characters `star-on-the-shore-en/character/<slug of English name>` — owned by the unit whose pages hold the stat block; others refer by that id (dangling until it exists — list in the report; no stubs). Cultist Summary (p. 62, unit core) refers to the town unit's cultist records.
- Star Spawn → `instance_of` the shared `coc:creature:star-spawn-of-cthulhu` (Grep first); other known Mythos beings → shared records.
- Coverage file `checks/20261123-star/star-<unit>.md`; art mapping `art-<unit>.json`, atmosphere `atmosphere-<unit>.json`, proposals `proposals-<unit>.json`; picture prefix `star-<unit>-`.
- completeness/scenario_check at the end on the whole book into `checks/20261123-star/completeness-<unit>` / `scenario-<unit>` (others' gaps expected); `python -B tools/check.py kb/books/star-on-the-shore-en` — 0 errors in your files.
